import pandas as pd
files={'DL':'airlines/DL.csv','AA':'airlines/AA.csv','UA':'airlines/UA.csv'}
frames=[]
for carrier,path in files.items():
 d=pd.read_csv(path); d['carrier']=carrier; frames.append(d)
f=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(f),'unique ids',f.flight_id.nunique(),'duplicate rows',f.flight_id.duplicated(keep=False).sum())
print('duplicate id counts',f.flight_id.value_counts().loc[lambda x:x>1].to_dict())
print('cancelled/actual anomalies',f.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict(),f.loc[f.cancelled & f.actual_dep.notna()].shape, f.loc[(~f.cancelled) & f.actual_dep.isna()].shape)
# deduplicate flight ID, preserving first, then filter dates
f=f.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
f['date']=pd.to_datetime(f['date'])
f=f[f.date.dt.month.isin([1,2])].copy()
# scheduled and actual minutes; midnight rollover actual relative to scheduled calendar date
f['sched_min']=f.sched_dep.str.slice(0,2).astype(int)*60+f.sched_dep.str.slice(3,5).astype(int)
f['actual_min']=f.actual_dep.fillna('').str.slice(0,2).replace('',pd.NA).astype('Int64')*60 + f.actual_dep.fillna('').str.slice(3,5).replace('',pd.NA).astype('Int64')
f['delay']=f['actual_min']-f['sched_min']
# if actual is next day (actual clock less than sched), add 1440; only completed
f.loc[f.actual_min.notna() & (f.actual_min < f.sched_min),'delay'] += 1440
completed=f[~f.cancelled].copy(); delayed=completed[completed.delay>15].copy()
print('completed',len(completed),'delayed',len(delayed),'delay range',completed.delay.min(),completed.delay.max())
print('delayed by carrier',delayed.carrier.value_counts().to_dict())
w=pd.read_csv('weather.csv')
w['bad']=(w.wx_code.isin(['TS','SN','+RA'])) | ((w.wx_code=='FG') & (w.visibility_mi<1.0))
print('weather duplicate keys',w.duplicated(['airport','date','hour']).sum(),'bad hours',w.bad.sum())
delayed['hour']=delayed.sched_dep.str[:2].astype(int)
joined=delayed.merge(w,left_on=['origin','date','hour'],right_on=['airport','date','hour'],how='left',validate='many_to_one',indicator=True)
print('join status',joined._merge.value_counts().to_dict(),'bad counts',joined.bad.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print(joined.groupby('carrier').agg(delayed=('flight_id','size'),bad=('bad','sum')))
print('pct',100*joined.bad.sum()/len(joined))
print(joined.loc[joined.bad,['flight_id','date','origin','sched_dep','wx_code','visibility_mi']].to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
files={'DL':'airlines/DL.csv','AA':'airlines/AA.csv','UA':'airlines/UA.csv'}
fl=pd.concat([pd.read_csv(p).assign(carrier=c) for c,p in files.items()], ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(fl),'unique ids',fl.flight_id.nunique(),'dup rows',fl.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
# dedupe exact flight records by flight id
fl=fl.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
fl['date_dt']=pd.to_datetime(fl['date'])
fl=fl[fl.date_dt.dt.month.isin([1,2]) & fl.date_dt.dt.year.eq(2025)]
print('filtered',len(fl), 'cancelled',fl.cancelled.sum(), 'cancelled actual nonnull',fl.loc[fl.cancelled,'actual_dep'].notna().sum())
# parse scheduled and actual as minutes from midnight, actual crossing midnight naturally adjust if less than sched
for col in ['sched_dep','actual_dep']:
    hm=fl[col].str.split(':',expand=True)
    fl[col+'_min']=pd.to_numeric(hm[0])*60+pd.to_numeric(hm[1])
fl['delay']=fl.actual_dep_min-fl.sched_dep_min
# adjust after midnight if completed and raw actual less sched; but ambiguity: actual date next day, documentation says may after midnight
fl.loc[fl.delay<0,'delay'] += 1440
fl['delayed']=(~fl.cancelled)&(fl.delay>15)
delayed=fl[fl.delayed].copy()
print('completed',(~fl.cancelled).sum(),'delayed',len(delayed),'delay stats',delayed.delay.describe().to_dict())
wx=pd.read_csv('weather.csv')
print('weather rows',len(wx),'unique keys',wx[['airport','date','hour']].drop_duplicates().shape[0], 'dups',wx.duplicated(['airport','date','hour']).sum(), 'date range',wx.date.min(),wx.date.max())
# scheduled hour
hm=delayed.sched_dep.str.split(':',expand=True)
delayed['hour']=pd.to_numeric(hm[0])
merged=delayed.merge(wx, left_on=['origin','date','hour'], right_on=['airport','date','hour'], how='left', validate='many_to_one')
merged['bad']=merged.wx_code.isin(['TS','SN','+RA']) | ((merged.wx_code=='FG') & (merged.visibility_mi<1.0))
print('delayed weather unmatched',merged.wx_code.isna().sum())
print(merged[['wx_code','visibility_mi','bad']].value_counts(dropna=False).to_string())
print('bad count',merged.bad.sum(),'total',len(merged),'pct',merged.bad.mean()*100)
print(merged.groupby('carrier').agg(delayed=('flight_id','size'),bad=('bad','sum')))
